question: Does the already-fixed object-noun context rule recover both reversed same-action roles better than the fixed anchored edit matcher on entirely different toys and participants?
design: Use only author training-split assembly recordings; no policy here has been trained on Assembly101. Exclude any toy ID or participant ID present in the 60 matched discovery-set recordings. Require same-toy, distinct-person pairs after exclusion. Take the entire eligible panel if accessible within the annotation-only acquisition budget. No outcome-dependent replacement. Same foreground unique-role labeling, 2-direction evaluation and full candidate sets as development. Include all qualifying distinct non-overlapping reversals; count both directions. Do not loosen subject/toy exclusions if small.
methods: Freeze the 16-neighbor bag of other noun labels and squared cosine, full-sequence forced-anchor Levenshtein, and uniform chance with original tie conventions. No fitting or parameter changes.
primary: On reversed swaps, compare their both-cues-exact fractional credit paired on identical tasks. Average directions and swaps within toy, then give each toy equal weight. Show means, delta, positive/negative/zero toy counts, number of recording pairs and unique-hit toys. Conditional paired nonparametric 95% interval by resampling toys 10000 times with random.Random(20261120); interval descriptive, especially if individual participants appear across toys.
threshold: Only call this independent confirmation for these two specified rules if at least eight eligible toys and twenty distinct physical recording pairs contribute a reversed swap, estimated mean advantage at least ten percentage points and paired lower endpoint >0. Otherwise report sparse, uncertain or contrary evidence. Positive smaller samples do not meet this gate. Descriptive secondary measures include both-cue success for same-order cases and single-cue scores for the unchanged population.
acquisition: Previously viewed one published validation split. Acquire identifiers and labels without computing method scores. Record all attrition, split provenance, exact identities/fingerprints privately, any access/budget issues. No cross-domain or raw-image performance claim, no further fitting or retries on validation.
